_about: A typical modern 7-iron for the exploded view. Lengths in inches as makers list them. 'estimate' marks shape numbers with no maker figure; the head outline is a generic cavity blade, not any brand's head.

sources.t200: Titleist T200 (2023) 7-iron: loft 30.5 deg, lie 63 deg, length 37 in (Titleist Canada listing and retailers). https://titleist.ca/product/t200/556C.html
sources.shaft_tip: .355 in taper-tip iron shafts widen to about .370 in at the top of the hosel; parallel-tip shafts are .370 in. https://kbs.kayako.com/article/2-what-is-the-difference-between-tapered-355-and-parallel-370-tip-shafts

sources.ferrule: Iron ferrules for .355 taper tips sold as 1 in long. https://www.valuegolf.com/10-1-355-taper-tip-iron-ferrules
